dedupe_keys.name: usgs snow to flow data pipeline

description: Snow to Flow is a US Geological Survey visualization and reproducible R pipeline explaining how western US snowpack relates to streamflow. Its targets workflow retrieves SNOTEL observations, applies configurable water-year and station thresholds, and generates maps and charts for the public site. Users can set the analysis year and study dates, then produce processed snow-water-equivalent summaries and visual outputs. Geographic coverage is western US stations served by the upstream network; the published site presents a current season, not a general hydrological simulator. The repository LICENSE.md grants free CC0 terms and documents the pipeline command. A limitation is that it downloads upstream records when run, and a snowpack percentile alone does not predict reservoir inflow or water-supply reliability. Its code can support data preparation and communication for snowmelt-sensitive water planning. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis is a separate meteorological source. No SNOTEL record or R package was downloaded.
name: USGS Snow to Flow data pipeline
